t: An open source desktop AI client for cloud and local language models.
steps: Find Cherry Studio on its official site or public code page.
Ask IT to approve the install.
Download the installer for your system.
Add a provider with an API key or point the app at a local Ollama or LM Studio server.
Install a local model if you want a fully on-device setup.
Review the privacy settings and turn off any usage sharing you do not want.
